given: a stock row whose inventory_code is a well-formed location-batch-serial code such as "A12-B7-S001"
when: the migration backfills the new columns
then: batch_number holds the second hyphen-delimited segment and serial_number holds the third segment of that code

independence.rationale: AC1 only asserts the columns exist; this adds the distinct outcome that a conforming code is parsed by delimiter into the correct segment values
